hints.title: Multiplicative Path Probability
hints.text: The probability of a path is the product of its edge probabilities. We wish to maximize this product.

hints.title: Dijkstra Variation
hints.text: Adapt shortest path algorithms using a max-priority structure keyed on path probability instead of additive distance.

hints.title: Early Termination
hints.text: When the destination node is extracted from the priority structure, its recorded probability is maximal.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unordered graph traversals fail to find optimal multiplicative paths on cyclic graphs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Max-priority queue explores paths in descending probability order in O((V + E) log V).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate adapts Dijkstras algorithm by maximizing edge probability products.
